name: M3_DPS170MI_GetUserJobSts
description: Retrieve the current batch update status for a user’s distribution order inbox. The status flag indicates whether the background job that transfers records from the inbox into live distribution order files is currently running or not. Just before an update starts, the status is set to `01` (busy). When the update job finishes, it resets the status to `00` (ready). Use this status check to control when a new update is started so that overlapping jobs for the same user are avoided.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which the user's update job status is checked.

inputParameters.name: STA2
inputParameters.description: Update job status code for the user, normally returned by the transaction, with typical values '00' = ready and '01' = busy.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for which this update job status record is returned.

outputParameters.name: USID
outputParameters.description: User ID for which the update job status is stored.

outputParameters.name: STA2
outputParameters.description: Current update job status code for the user, typically '00' = ready and '01' = busy.
